When disaster strikes, will you bug in or bug out?

Bug In Pros:

  • The safety and security of your own home
  • Large storage without regard to carrying weight
  • Potentially maintain electricity, water, and "creature comforts" (even if off-grid)
  • Neighbors can be a structure of community support
  • Ability to garden
  • Easier to protect children

Bug In Cons:

  • May become stuck there, just waiting out the disaster
  • Difficult to hide or ghost
  • Need to defend property
  • Larger initial costs

Bug Out Pros:

  • Can stay on the move
  • Able to hide easier
  • Can remove yourself from the chaos
  • Easier if done solo or with small adult group
  • Larger area, more freedom
  • Able to hunt or fish

Bug Out Cons:

  • Exposed to nature and the elements
  • Difficult with family or children
  • Concern with water gathering
  • Potential to isolate yourself from information flow

What do you plan on doing? Will you remain in your home and defend your property from the hordes or will you remove yourself from harm's way and make your way out in the boonies?
Unfortunately, I can't give nearly as detailed a response as the initial post, so all I can really say is "depends on what happens."
